content:
Hi, I am Gabriel Wu, currently an AI engineer at NVIDIA.
I was to prove some theorems about KV cache reuse using Lean but found that Eckart-Yound-Mirsky was missing, so I drafted this PR https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/41477. The work was done by LLM under my supervision.
Can anyone help review it? Thanks a lot!

I would suggest splitting the PR to begin with. Also, at a (very quick) glance, you may probably want to rearrange your code a bit. The long lines of have blocks that LLMs (or for that matter humans!) like are usually refactored more compactly afterwards
Thanks for the suggestion. Have done some compaction as well as splitting the PR.

This requires a bit of a design discussion. Does anyone have opinions about the current way matrix norms are set up? Current, the file Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Normed contains multiple norm instances that are each scoped. I believe this is the design that this new PR copies.

But I'm personally not sure I'm happy with the way matrix norms are set up. For example, any statement which involves multiple types of norms is not possible to state idiomatically. I wonder if maybe a type tag makes more sense.

Also, I believe ContinuousLinearMap already has the operator norm instance. Do we want compatibility between the normed space instances on ContinuousLinearMap and LinearMap?
@Jireh Loreaux and @Anatole Dedecker we discussed the issue with matrix norms a little in Providence, I don't recall the solution you proposed but it sounded reasonable and necessary

Would it be possible to use the WithLp type tag for matrices and linear maps for the Frobenius norm?

We can also instead make a WithLpq tag.

@Niels Voss I have built a prototype using WithLp at https://github.com/lucifer1004/mathlib4/blob/hilbert-schmidt-withlp/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/HilbertSchmidt.lean , could you have a look?

Unfortunately I can't be of all that much help because whether or not your approach is right depends on how the mathlib maintainers want to handle linear map norms and inner product spaces. Some comments

  • trace_adjoint_comp_eq_sum_inner can probably be moved to another file
  • (𝕜 := 𝕜) on line 100 can be dropped
  • Should maybe this also be defined for some subset of ContinuousLinearMap in addition to finite dimensional linear maps? I'm not sure about this?
  • My suggestion to use WithLp 2 may or may not be a good idea. One possibility which might be better is to define a new typeclass.

I think if using WithLp 2is the right approach then your implementation in the short HilbertSchmidt.lean file you just sent is pretty good (I have not looked at other parts of your code from the original PR) but I don't know if this is the right approach.

Should maybe this also be defined for some subset of ContinuousLinearMap in addition to finite dimensional linear maps? I'm not sure about this?

I would indeed expect some bundled type like ContinuousLinearMap, written as E ->HS[𝕜] F.

The suggested implementation requires FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E and FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F. Hilbert-Schmidt operators are well-defined for infinite dimensional spaces too. Maybe using HilbertBasis instead of OrthonormalBasis can help achieve this. This generalization could perhaps be left as a "ToDo".
